name: Google Sheets content calendar to sprkly

parameters.content:
## Post from a Google Sheet with sprkly

### How it works
- Every 15 minutes it reads the rows with Status **Approved**.
- It checks each row: a Row ID, a caption, a time that has not come yet, an account, and web links for media.
- A bad row gets Status **Error** and a plain reason.
- A good row is scheduled in sprkly. External ID `sheet-<Row ID>` means a re-run never posts twice.
- The row gets **Scheduled**, the sprkly Post ID and the time.
- Every 5 minutes it asks sprkly which posts changed. A post that went out writes **Published** and the link. A failed one writes **Failed** and the reason.

### Setup
- Get an API key in sprkly: Settings, then API Keys. API docs: https://sprkly.app/docs/api
- Make a Bearer Auth credential with the key. Pick it in the 3 sprkly nodes.
- Add your Google Sheets login to the 3 sheet nodes, and pick your sheet in each.
- Sheet columns: Row ID, Status, Caption, Schedule Time, Accounts, Media URL, sprkly Post ID, Scheduled For, Link, Error.
- Set your time zone in Workflow settings. Times in the sheet use it.
- Turn the workflow on. Status updates start from then.

### Customization
- Change how often it runs in **Every 15 minutes**.
- For TikTok and YouTube, add a Title column and put it in the request in **Match accounts to rows**.

## Read and check approved rows
Every 15 minutes, only rows with Status Approved. Each row needs a Row ID, a caption, a time that has not come yet, and an account. A row that fails gets Status Error and the reason.

## Match accounts
One call to sprkly per run gets your accounts. Write each one as platform:handle, like instagram:myhandle or telegram:My channel. Put commas between several.

## This posts for real
An empty time means "post now" in the sprkly API. This workflow refuses that: a row with no time stops at **Check each row** and never gets here.

## Write the result back
A repeat of External ID sheet-<Row ID> writes the first post's ID, status and time, not a new post. Any other answer puts sprkly's reason in the Error column.

## Track what happened
Every 5 minutes it reads the posts sprkly changed since the last run. Only sheet- posts that went out or failed update a row, found by Row ID. More than 100 changes? The next run picks up the rest.
